title: A Better Way to Run the Weekly Meeting
summaryZh: 兩位同事討論如何把冗長的每週例會，改成書面更新加上短時間解決問題。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Do you have a minute to talk about our Friday meeting?
sentences.zh: 你有空談一下我們星期五的會議嗎？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Sure, although I can probably guess what you are going to say.
sentences.zh: 可以，不過我大概猜得到你要說什麼。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: It takes an hour, but most weeks we do not make any real decisions.
sentences.zh: 它花上一小時，但大多數星期我們都沒有做出真正的決定。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I agree, and half the meeting is just people reading numbers from the screen.
sentences.zh: 我同意，而且一半的時間只是大家照著螢幕念數字。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: What if everyone sent a short written update before Thursday afternoon?
sentences.zh: 如果每個人在星期四下午前交一份簡短的書面更新呢？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Then we could read the updates first and use the meeting only for problems.
sentences.zh: 那我們可以先讀更新，只把會議時間用來處理問題。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Exactly, and if there are no problems, we can cancel the meeting that week.
sentences.zh: 沒錯，如果沒有問題，那一週就可以取消會議。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I like the idea, but some people may forget to send their updates.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡這個想法，但有些人可能會忘記交更新。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: We can make a simple template with three questions and set an automatic reminder.
sentences.zh: 我們可以做一份只有三個問題的簡單範本，再設自動提醒。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: That would help, especially if the update takes less than five minutes to write.
sentences.zh: 那會有幫助，尤其是更新內容不到五分鐘就能寫完的話。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: For urgent issues, we could still have a fifteen minute call on Friday morning.
sentences.zh: 遇到緊急問題時，我們星期五早上仍然可以開十五分鐘的通話。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Let us try it for a month and ask the team what they think afterward.
sentences.zh: 我們先試一個月，之後再問團隊的想法。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Good plan, and I will explain that the goal is to protect everyone's time.
sentences.zh: 好主意，我會說明這樣做是為了珍惜每個人的時間。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: If it works, Friday might finally feel like a day for finishing work.
sentences.zh: 如果有效，星期五或許終於會像是能把工作完成的一天。

questions.q: What is the main problem with the current Friday meeting?
options: It lasts an hour without producing many decisions
It begins too early for most team members
It includes people from the wrong department

questions.q: What do A and B want people to do before the meeting?
How long will they test the new system?
